newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Power plans 4,000MW LNG power complex.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Power plans 4,000MW LNG power complex.

text.p: State utility Taiwan Power Co said on Monday it would invest T$122 billion to build a power plant fired by liquefied natural gas (LNG) with a capacity of some 4,000 megawatts (MW) over nine years near northern Taoyuan.
Under the plan, the power station complex at Tatan will have 10 to 12 LNG-fired generating units when completed, Taipower official Wang Cheng-yu said told Reuters by telephone.
"Each unit will provide about 400 megawatts," Wang said. "The first unit will begin to operate in early 2001."
Taipower plans to complete the project within nine years, bringing total capacity to 4,000 megawatts, Wang added.
The plan still needs the cabinet's final approval.
